objective: Discover concrete source words with reproducible document/row/numeric-block structural roles on heldout documents, as a direct precursor to probable functional-role testing.

roles.DOCUMENT_FIRST_LEXICAL: word is the first lexical source word in a document containing at least two lexical words
roles.DOCUMENT_LAST_LEXICAL: word is the last lexical source word in a document containing at least two lexical words
roles.ROW_FIRST_LEXICAL: word belongs to exactly one source row and is the first lexical word of that row; row has at least two substantive source words
roles.ROW_LAST_LEXICAL: word belongs to exactly one source row and is the last lexical word of that row; row has at least two substantive source words
roles.BEFORE_NUMERIC_BLOCK_GE2: word immediately precedes at least two consecutive numeric-like source words on the same unambiguous row
roles.AFTER_NUMERIC_BLOCK_GE2: word immediately follows at least two consecutive numeric-like source words on the same unambiguous row
roles.BETWEEN_NUMERIC_NEIGHBORS: word is immediately preceded and followed by numeric-like source words on the same unambiguous row

heldout_candidate_gate.null: cross-fitted Poisson-binomial upper tail; each heldout occurrence uses the matching train fold's generic background rate for the same structural role

include: adjacent structural types for numeric-block roles

positive_ladder.R7_C1: unchanged candidate survives complete-region holdout where support permits
positive_ladder.R7_C2: candidate advantage collapses under structure-destroying within-document/within-row permutations that preserve word and numeric-type frequencies
positive_ladder.R7_C3: probable structural functional-role candidate may be admitted, such as opener-like, closer-like, numeric-block-introducer-like, or numeric-block-separator-like; exact lexical meaning remains forbidden
positive_ladder.EXTERNAL: independent editorial source required for external replication credit

allowed: concrete source word with reproducible structural-role enrichment
